note: City of Marshfield fairgrounds at 513 E 17th St; the Central Wisconsin State Fair Association runs the campground on open grass fields north of the horse arenas. Over 100 water/electric sites and 500+ primitive spaces. Showers and restrooms in the Lang 4-H building, by key from the Fair Office on weekdays; WiFi codes sold there. Generators not allowed. Dump station by the Round Barn ($5). No long-term camping. --Claude
